detailed_description: VAT Calculator is a comprehensive tool for calculating Value Added Tax across European countries. It supports standard, reduced, and super-reduced VAT rates for all EU member states. You can add VAT to a net amount, remove VAT from a gross amount, or calculate the VAT portion only.
usage_steps: Enter the amount you want to calculate VAT for
Select the calculation mode (add VAT, remove VAT, or VAT only)
Choose a country or enter a custom VAT rate
Select the rate type (standard, reduced, or super-reduced)
View the calculated net amount, VAT amount, and gross amount
usage_examples: Calculate VAT for invoices and business transactions
Determine net price from VAT-inclusive prices
Compare VAT rates across different EU countries
